concrete_facts: Both actual AVSS R components have 256 nodes and 86 anchors: 85 compact-device terminals plus public P_AVSS.
The 85 compact terminals are 28 HBT emitters, 55 rppd electrical ends and 2 MIM bottoms.
Public SUB is a distinct 180-node/91-anchor component; finite BULK/contact networks must not be collapsed into AVSS.
Existing AVSS routing already includes a 6um TopMetal1 cross-row strap and 15 six-um TopMetal2 row straps; no missing-strap cause is asserted.

At exact row23023, parent row0 reference/tail emitter returns are 59.29/75.33mV and row14 reference/tail returns are 226.62/237.61mV. This is source-bound spatial correlation, not proof of a specific limiting edge.
